PNN-001 Under investigation

Caught in their own Webb

Last to announce. First under investigation. PNN examines a suspicious delay in the Black Webb Bandits' name reveal.

Subject team
Black Webb Bandits
Opened
October 4, 2026 at 7:21 PM (America/Denver)
PNN threat rating
Temporarily contained

The incident

The Black Webb Bandits were the final team to submit their name. Rumors of cold feet circulated. The word "chicken" was mentioned. PNN has opened a file to determine whether this was a failure of nerve or simply a failure to escape the panther.

Suspected motive

Remain unavailable for comment until the coast was clear. Announcing a spider-themed team while a panther is on patrol may require delicate timing.

Investigator's note

The chicken connection remains unsupported. Clueso prefers the panther theory. A reconstruction featuring a panther is, regrettably, not evidence against the Prowling Purrpetrators. He has requested more facts and fewer obstacles to his conclusion.

Official PNN assessment

Name recovered. Alibi pending. The Black Webb Bandits are officially on the board; the reason for their late arrival remains under investigation.
